classes.name: Caballero
classes.visualBrief: armadura completa, hombreras y protección de piernas; capa heráldica; silueta defensiva
classes.note: Complete first-pass package is versioned: two source masters, six action strips, 24 native 32x64 frames, six previews and six QA reports. Technical generation is complete; residual background/edge pixels and artistic approval remain for the global review. Not integrated into runtime.

classes.name: Duelista

Technical generation is complete; review the cut-out edges/possible halo in the global visual pass. Hands remain empty; weapons are separate layers. Not integrated into runtime.

policy: Keep all source masters and generated packages isolated from public runtime assets until six strips per class pass technical QA and global visual approval. Do not rebuild finished classes during the current rework; harmonize them only in the final pass.
